id.title: Sample identifier
id.description: The identifier property will be automatically populated with a DOI upon the creation of an IGSN ID. The system will assign a random DOI suffix unless a specific suffix is supplied using Fabrica or DataCite APIs.

doi.$comment: idea to have samples with an id, but without a DOI (yet)??? It might be an issue that this separate doi field cannot be set read-only

titles.title: Sample titles or labels
titles.description: The title property should include appropriate elements that would help find and distinguish a sample. If the title is an institutional identifier, the appropriate field should be set to true.

isInstitutionalIdentifier.title: Institutional Identifier
isInstitutionalIdentifier.description: If the title is an institutional identifier, it should be set to true.

sourceId.title: Source ID
sourceId.description: The ID of the heritage object from which the sample was taken
sourceId.$comment: (1) not using in-cordra references, (2)maps to relatedIdentifiers type isDerivedFrom

sourceLabel.title: Source Label
sourceLabel.description: A short label for the source object, for display purposes.

sourceType.title: Source Type
sourceType.description: The type of heritage object from which the sample was taken

sampleSiteDescription.title: Sample Site Description
sampleSiteDescription.description: A description of the location of the sample on the source object

sampleSiteAnnotationUrl.title: Sample Site Annotations
sampleSiteAnnotationUrl.description: A URL to document to location of the site relative to an image of the source. It is recommended to use a link to a IIIF manifest, or a PID landing page for further documentation.

creators.title: Creators
creators.description: The creators are the people or organisations that created, collected or processed the sample.

custodian.title: Custodian
custodian.description: The custodian organisation is the organisation or person that hosts the sample.
custodian.$comment: maps to contributor with type HostingInstitution

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: The publisher is the organisation or person that publishes the record.

publicationYear.title: Publication Year
publicationYear.description: The publication year is the year when the record was first made available to the research community.

dates.title: Dates
dates.description: Associated dates for the sample. If the date is not known precisely, use the first of January of the year to indicate the year.

collectedDate.title: Collected Date
collectedDate.description: The collected date is the date when the sample was collected.

mountedDate.title: Mounted Date
mountedDate.description: The mounted date is the date when the sample was mounted.

consumedDate.title: Consumed Date
consumedDate.description: The consumed date is the date when the sample was consumed.

destroyedDate.title: Destroyed Date
destroyedDate.description: The destroyed date is the date when the sample was destroyed.

publishedDate.title: Published Date
publishedDate.description: The published date is the date when the record was published.

alternateIdentifiers.title: Alternate Identifiers
alternateIdentifiers.description: The alternateIdentifier property may be used to enter any other identifiers for the material sample, including local sample identifiers.

subjects.title: Subjects, Keywords and Classification codes
subjects.description: The free-text subject property contains the 'subject, keyword, classification code, or key phrase describing the resource.' For IGSN IDs, this is the materials that compose the sample. Since materials may be categorized under different schemata, the sub-properties subjectScheme and schemeURI should also be included whenever possible.
